---
title: Code Annotations (brand background, Skylighting)
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'let bgcolor = rgb\("#ffeecc"\)'
          - '#quarto-code-annotation\(|annotations: \("1": 1\)'
          - 'set block\(fill: rgb\("#ffeecc"\)\)'
        -
          - 'fill: luma\(230\), width'
